title: Chinagodrar military camp attack
description: Militants attacked Niger's military post at Chinagodrar near the Mali border on January 9, 2020. Reuters subsequently reported that at least 89 Nigerien soldiers were killed. French fighter jets were sent to help repel the attackers.

title: Yeti Airlines Flight 691 crash
description: Yeti Airlines Flight 691, an ATR 72-500 flying from Kathmandu, crashed on approach to Pokhara on January 15, 2023, killing all 68 passengers and four crew. Nepal's final investigation identified inadvertent movement of both condition levers to the feathered position as the most probable cause, resulting in loss of thrust, an aerodynamic stall and ground impact.

title: Monterey Park mass shooting
description: A gunman attacked Star Ballroom Dance Studio in Monterey Park late on January 21, 2023 local time, January 22 UTC, killing eleven people and wounding nine. The attack occurred during Lunar New Year celebrations. He subsequently entered another dance hall in Alhambra, where he was disarmed, and later died by suicide.

title: Peshawar mosque bombing
description: A suicide bombing inside the Police Lines mosque in Peshawar on January 30, 2023 killed 84 people in the revised police count, mostly police personnel. A TTP commander claimed responsibility, but the group's spokesman denied involvement. Pakistani investigators later attributed the attack to Jamaat-ul-Ahrar, a TTP faction.

title: Central Chile Wildfires
location: Viña del Mar, Valparaíso Region, Chile
description: Wildfires beginning on February 2, 2024 devastated communities around Vina del Mar in Chile's Valparaiso Region. Prosecutors later confirmed 138 deaths, including later fatalities, superseding lower early totals. Thousands of homes were damaged or destroyed.

title: Nakhon Ratchasima (Korat) mall shooting
description: On February 8-9, 2020, a Thai soldier killed 29 people in a rampage in Nakhon Ratchasima that included a military base and Terminal 21 shopping mall. He was killed by security forces after an overnight siege, bringing the total including the attacker to 30. It was Thailand's deadliest mass shooting at the time.

title: Petropolis floods and mudslides
description: Extreme rainfall caused catastrophic flooding and landslides in Petropolis, Brazil, on February 15, 2022. More than 250 mm fell within hours. A later disaster study recorded 233 deaths, the highest toll for a disaster in the city's history.

title: Hanau far-right shootings
description: On February 19, 2020, a racist attacker killed nine people of immigrant backgrounds at sites in Hanau, Germany. He also killed his mother and died by suicide. Ten victims were killed; the perpetrator's death is excluded from this count. Authorities treated the attack as far-right terrorism.

title: Russian invasion of Ukraine
description: Russia began its full-scale invasion of Ukraine on February 24, 2022. By early January 2023, UN human rights monitors had verified at least 6,919 civilian deaths since the invasion, while warning the actual toll was higher. This is a dated cumulative civilian count and excludes military deaths; it is not a count of deaths on February 24.

title: Tempe passenger train collision
description: A passenger train and a freight train collided head-on near Tempe, Greece, late on February 28, 2023, killing 57 people. A 2025 safety investigation identified human error, outdated infrastructure and systemic railway failures. The crash triggered widespread protests over railway safety.

title: Peshawar mosque bombing
description: A suicide bomber attacked a Shia mosque in Peshawar's Qissa Khwani Bazaar area during Friday prayers on March 4, 2022. Reporting the next day put the death toll at 63 after injured victims died. Islamic State's regional affiliate claimed responsibility.

title: Atlanta spa shootings
description: A gunman attacked three Atlanta-area massage businesses on March 16, 2021, killing eight people, including six women of Asian descent.

title: China Eastern Airlines Flight MU5735 crash
description: China Eastern Airlines Flight MU5735, a Boeing 737-800 travelling from Kunming to Guangzhou, descended rapidly and crashed near Wuzhou, Guangxi, on March 21, 2022. All 132 people aboard died. The April 2022 preliminary investigation did not determine the cause; debris examination and flight-data analysis were continuing.

title: Boulder supermarket shooting
description: A gunman killed ten people, including police officer Eric Talley, at the King Soopers supermarket in Boulder, Colorado, on March 22, 2021. Police captured the suspect alive. An arrest affidavit said he purchased a Ruger AR-556 semiautomatic pistol on March 16, six days before the attack.

title: Crocus City Hall Concert Hall Attack
description: Gunmen attacked Crocus City Hall in Krasnogorsk, outside Moscow, on March 22, 2024, shooting concertgoers and setting the venue on fire. AP's August 2025 trial reporting gives 149 deaths and more than 600 wounded. Islamic State claimed responsibility for the attack.

title: Sudan civil war begins
description: War between the Sudanese Armed Forces and Rapid Support Forces began on April 15, 2023. In its update covering events through November 24, ACLED recorded more than 12,190 reported political-violence deaths since the outbreak. This is a dated, incomplete reported-death count excluding indirect mortality, not a final toll of the war.

title: Mexico City metro overpass collapse
description: An elevated section of Mexico City Metro Line 12 collapsed beneath a train between Olivos and Tezonco late on May 3, 2021 local time, May 4 UTC. Twenty-six people died and 79 were injured.

title: South Kivu floods and landslides
description: Heavy rain on May 4, 2023 triggered flooding and mudslides in Kalehe territory, South Kivu, destroying parts of Bushushu and Nyamukubi. A later MONUSCO appeal reported an official toll of 438 dead and more than 5,000 missing. The missing-person estimate is separate from confirmed deaths.

title: Allen outlet mall shooting
description: A gunman killed eight people and wounded seven at Allen Premium Outlets in Allen, Texas, on May 6, 2023. A police officer who was at the mall on another call shot and killed the attacker. The eight-victim total excludes the gunman.

title: Kabul maternity hospital attack
description: Gunmen attacked the MSF-supported maternity wing of Dasht-e-Barchi hospital in Kabul on May 12, 2020. Afghan authorities reported 24 people killed and more than 20 injured. MSF subsequently confirmed that the dead included 16 mothers, one MSF midwife and two children aged seven and eight.

title: Buffalo supermarket shooting
description: A white supremacist gunman attacked a Tops supermarket in Buffalo, New York, on May 14, 2022, killing ten Black people and injuring three others. He later pleaded guilty to state charges and received life imprisonment without parole.

title: Uvalde School Shooting
description: A gunman killed 19 children and two teachers at Robb Elementary School in Uvalde, Texas, on May 24, 2022. A US Justice Department review found a 77-minute gap between officers first arriving and confronting and killing the attacker. The victim count excludes the attacker.

title: Odisha train collision
description: On June 2, 2023, the Coromandel Express collided with a stationary freight train near Bahanaga Bazar in Odisha, and derailed coaches struck another passenger train. India's Ministry of Railways later reported 296 deaths. The disaster prompted investigations into signaling and railway safety failures.

title: Solhan village massacre
description: Armed attackers struck Solhan in Burkina Faso early on June 5, 2021, killing civilians including children and forcing residents to flee. Contemporary reporting put the provisional toll at about 160; UNICEF reported more than 130 civilian deaths. The larger number is a reported estimate, not a reconciled final count.

title: Hajj Extreme Heat Deaths
description: During the June 14-19, 2024 Hajj pilgrimage, extreme heat caused mass mortality among pilgrims in Saudi Arabia. WHO reported Saudi authorities' total of 1,301 deaths from heat exhaustion, with 83% among unauthorized pilgrims walking long distances. The toll covers the pilgrimage period, not a single day.
sources: Saudi Ministry of Municipalities and Housing

title: Mpondwe school massacre
description: An attack blamed on Allied Democratic Forces rebels at Mpondwe-Lhubiriha Secondary School in western Uganda on June 16, 2023 killed 42 people, according to a June 19 official update, including 37 students. Attackers set a dormitory on fire; victims also suffered gunshot and machete attacks.

title: Afghanistan earthquake (Khost and Paktika)
description: An earthquake struck Khost and Paktika in southeastern Afghanistan at 20:54 UTC on June 21, 2022, early June 22 locally. USGS lists magnitude 6.0. The UN's 2022 results report estimated 1,036 deaths, 2,924 injuries and damage to at least 4,500 homes.

title: Surfside condominium collapse
description: The 12-storey Champlain Towers South condominium in Surfside, Florida, partially collapsed at about 01:30 local time on June 24, 2021, killing 98 people. NIST opened a technical investigation into the collapse.

title: Irapuato rehabilitation center massacre
description: Three armed men attacked the Recuperando mi Vida rehabilitation centre in Irapuato, Guanajuato, on July 1, 2020. Later reporting put the death toll at 28. The killings occurred amid a series of attacks on rehabilitation centres in the state.

title: Highland Park parade shooting
description: A gunman opened fire from a rooftop during the Independence Day parade in Highland Park, Illinois, on July 4, 2022, killing seven people and injuring dozens. Prosecutors subsequently brought 117 charges, including 21 first-degree murder counts covering the seven victims.

title: Wayanad Landslides
description: Landslides struck Wayanad, Kerala, early on July 30, 2024 local time, July 29 UTC, after intense rain. A government answer to Parliament in April 2025 reported 298 deaths, including 32 missing people declared deceased, based on Kerala's official accounting.

title: Assassination of Ismail Haniyeh
description: Hamas political leader Ismail Haniyeh and his bodyguard were killed at a residence in Tehran around 2 a.m. on July 31, 2024 local time, July 30 UTC. Accounts differed over whether a projectile or a previously planted explosive caused the blast.

title: Beirut Port Explosion
description: An ammonium nitrate explosion at the Port of Beirut on August 4, 2020 killed 218 people and wounded about 7,000, according to Human Rights Watch's investigation.

title: Maui wildfire
description: A wildfire that began near Lahaina, Maui, on the morning of August 8, 2023 local time later spread through the town. Investigators found that broken electrical lines started the fire and surviving embers rekindled in strong winds. The confirmed toll reached 102 after a later death was attributed to fire injuries in June 2024.

title: Voepass Flight 2283 Crash
description: Voepass Flight 2283, an ATR 72-500 flying from Cascavel to Sao Paulo-Guarulhos, crashed in Vinhedo on August 9, 2024. All 58 passengers and four crew members died. The crash occurred well into the flight, not shortly after takeoff.

title: Haiti earthquake
description: A magnitude 7.2 earthquake struck southwestern Haiti on August 14, 2021, destroying thousands of homes and damaging infrastructure. The IFRC subsequently reported 2,248 deaths and 12,763 injuries. These are later reported totals, rather than the initial rescue-period count.

title: Kabul airport bombing
description: An ISIS-K suicide bomber attacked crowds at Kabul airport's Abbey Gate on August 26, 2021, during evacuation operations. Thirteen US service members and around 170 Afghan civilians were killed. The subsequent US military investigation described one bomber, correcting early reports of a complex attack.

title: Apalachee High School Shooting
description: A 14-year-old student opened fire at Apalachee High School near Winder, Georgia, on September 4, 2024. Two students and two teachers were killed, and nine other people were injured. The suspect was taken into custody without incident and charged with four counts of felony murder.

title: Luding earthquake (Sichuan)
description: An earthquake struck Luding County in Sichuan, China, on September 5, 2022, triggering landslides and damaging buildings and roads. The Hong Kong Red Cross reported 93 deaths, more than 400 injured and 25 missing as of September 11; later landslide research reports 424 injuries.

title: Marrakesh–Safi earthquake
description: A magnitude 6.8 earthquake struck Morocco's High Atlas region at 22:11 UTC on September 8, 2023, 23:11 locally. Villages in Al Haouz and surrounding areas were devastated. IFRC retrospective reporting records at least 2,960 deaths and more than 5,600 injuries.

title: Derna dam collapses and floods
description: Two dams above Derna failed early on September 11, 2023 after Storm Daniel's heavy rainfall, flooding the city. OCHA's November 28 reporting recorded 4,352 deaths in the wider Libyan flood disaster, with thousands separately missing. Amnesty documented neglected dam maintenance and failures in disaster preparedness.

title: Tabas Coal Mine Explosion
description: A methane explosion at the Madanjoo coal mine near Tabas, Iran, on the evening of September 21, 2024 killed 52 miners, according to later reporting. Early rescue reports gave lower recovered-body counts while other workers remained trapped.

title: Kaaj education centre bombing (Kabul)
description: A suicide bombing at the Kaaj education centre in Kabul's Dasht-e Barchi district on September 30, 2022 killed 54 people and wounded 114, according to later UN reporting. Most victims were young Hazara women and girls. A later UN report attributes a claim of responsibility to ISIL-K, although an earlier Dutch government report described the attack as unclaimed.

title: Herat earthquakes
description: A sequence of strong earthquakes struck Herat province in western Afghanistan between October 7 and 15, 2023. WHO reported 1,482 deaths and 2,100 injuries from the sequence, with widespread destruction of homes and damage to health facilities.

title: Israel-Hamas war: Gaza deaths reported in 2023
description: The war began after the Hamas-led attack on Israel on October 7, 2023, followed by Israeli military operations in Gaza. By December 31, Gaza's Health Ministry reported 21,822 Palestinians killed and 56,451 injured in Gaza. This entry counts that dated Gaza total only, not deaths in Israel, later fatalities, or a final toll of the war.

title: Kunduz mosque bombing
description: A suicide bomber attacked the Sayed Abad Shia mosque in Kunduz on October 8, 2021. A later UNAMA report recorded at least 80 people killed and at least 150 wounded. Early reports used conflicting casualty figures, including a combined dead-and-injured total above 100.

title: Israel-Hezbollah conflict in Lebanon, 2023-2024
description: Cross-border hostilities between Israel and Hezbollah began on October 8, 2023 and escalated sharply in September 2024. A ceasefire took effect on November 27. On November 29, the UN reported Lebanese authorities' nonfinal toll of around 4,000 dead and over 16,000 injured since the conflict began.

title: Lewiston mass shooting
description: An Army reservist killed 18 people and injured 13 at a bowling alley and a bar in Lewiston, Maine, on October 25, 2023. He was found dead after a two-day search; investigators said he died by suicide. A state commission later found that local law enforcement and the Army Reserve missed opportunities to intervene before the attacks.

title: Mogadishu twin vehicle bombings
description: Two vehicle bombs exploded near Somalia's Education Ministry in Mogadishu on October 29, 2022. On November 1 the health minister reported 121 deaths, 333 injuries and ten people missing. Al-Shabaab claimed responsibility. An official told VOA that the second device was carried by a motorcycle pulling a trailer.

title: Seoul Halloween crowd crush (Itaewon)
description: A crowd crush in a narrow, sloping alley in Seoul's Itaewon district during Halloween celebrations on October 29, 2022 killed 159 people and injured 196. Police subsequently referred 23 officials to prosecutors over alleged failures in prevention and emergency response.

title: Valencia Flash Floods (DANA)
description: Extreme rainfall on October 29, 2024 caused flash floods in eastern Spain, especially Valencia province. By the first anniversary, 229 deaths were attributed to the disaster in Valencia and 237 across Spain. The numeric toll in this entry is Valencia's, not the nationwide total.

title: Jajarkot earthquake
description: An earthquake struck western Nepal at 23:47 local time, 18:02 UTC, on November 3, 2023. Nepal's health ministry review records 154 deaths across Jajarkot and Rukum West, with extensive damage to homes. Research describes the earthquake as moment magnitude 5.7, corresponding to a reported local magnitude of 6.4.
sources: Nepal Ministry of Health and Population

title: Piatra Neamț hospital fire
description: A fire broke out in the COVID-19 intensive-care unit of Piatra Neamt Emergency Hospital in Romania on November 14, 2020. Ten patients died, and officials initially reported seven people critically injured, including a doctor. Firefighters reported extinguishing the blaze in about 25 minutes.

title: Super Typhoon Rai
description: Typhoon Rai, known in the Philippines as Odette, struck the country on December 16, 2021, causing destructive winds, flooding and displacement. Philippine disaster reporting recorded 405 reported deaths. Initial situation reports included fatalities still undergoing validation.

title: Jishishan earthquake
description: An earthquake struck Jishishan County in Gansu, China, at 23:59 local time, 15:59 UTC, on December 18, 2023. Chinese authorities measured surface-wave magnitude 6.2. The earthquake killed 151 people across Gansu and Qinghai and injured nearly 1,000.

title: Prague university shooting
description: A student attacked Charles University's Faculty of Arts in Prague on December 21, 2023, killing 14 people and injuring 25 before dying by suicide. Police linked him to his father's killing earlier that day and to the murders of a man and infant six days earlier. Those three earlier victims are not included in this university-attack toll.

title: Jeju Air Flight 2216 Crash
description: Jeju Air Flight 2216 from Bangkok made a gear-up landing at Muan International Airport on December 29, 2024, overran the runway and struck a concrete structure. Of 181 occupants, 179 died and two survived with serious injuries. The preliminary investigation documented bird-strike evidence but did not establish the complete cause.
